from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import subprocess,re,json,hashlib
from v3_revision import ROOT,dump
r=ROOT/'results/revision-20261023/round2';text=(ROOT/'REVISION_V3_CHANGELOG.md').read_text();matches=list(re.finditer(r'^### Round2 (E\d+|D\d+) — .+$',text,re.M));assert len(matches)==13 and len({m.group(1) for m in matches})==13
blocks={m.group(1):text[m.start():matches[i+1].start() if i+1<len(matches) else text.index('\n## 待用户决定',m.start())] for i,m in enumerate(matches)};missing=[];counts={k:0 for k in blocks}
for p in (r/'evidence').glob('*.json'):
 d=json.loads(p.read_text());counts[d['step']]+=1
 for key in ['command','stdout','stderr']:
  if d[key] not in blocks[d['step']]:missing.append((p.name,key))
assert not missing,missing
old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:REVISION_V3_CHANGELOG.md'],cwd=ROOT,text=True);a=old.index('### Round2 E9 — ');b=old.index('### Round2 E10 — ',a);assert old[a:b]==blocks['E9']
record=dict(actual_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),receipt_count=sum(counts.values()),counts_by_step=counts,missing_original_command_or_stdout_or_stderr_inside_own_step=missing,E9_section_exactly_equal_HEAD=True,scope='Current structured receipts tested inside their own exact Round2 heading; snapshot excludes the new command receipt written after this audit.')
dump(r/'post-correction-audit/step-local-evidence-g15.json',record);print(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
